d: A sentient carnivorous plant creature with deep purple petals featuring light blue spots and a single curving stem topped with a bulbous purple head. The creature lacks a human-like face, age, or traditional clothing, consisting entirely of botanical structures including teal-blue leaves at the base. The lower body is a thick, rooted stalk of dark purple and indigo. BODY COLOR: Deep purple and indigo LEGS: Plantigrade, consisting of a thick rooted stalk and base leaves.
